headline: Another Bank in West Sumatra Closes, OJK Asks Depositors Not to Panic
summary: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) revoked the business license of PT BPR LPN Labuh Gunung in West Sumatra. Regulators asked customers not to panic, according to the report.
why: OJK is Indonesia's financial services regulator, overseeing banks and non-bank lenders, including rural banks (BPR).
original_headline: Satu Lagi Bank di Sumbar Tutup, OJK Minta Nasabah Tak Panik
